regression_risks.description: Removing host port is safe - internal DNS 'vault:8200' works. Only risk if external tools expect localhost:8200.
nginx will fail to start without certs. Must generate before deploy. No fallback.
api depends_on vault:healthy but healthcheck passes when SEALED. api starts, fails to read secrets. Need healthcheck that requires unsealed=true.
Validation script checks prometheus/grafana/alertmanager on host ports. Must update validation to use docker exec or nginx proxy.
File permissions only. Docker secrets mount preserves perms. App reads as nodejs user (UID 1001).
CA key not needed at runtime. Only ca.crt used by Vault for client verification.
Artifact cleanup only. No runtime dependencies.
Major architecture change. Requires config.ts to read from /run/secrets/*. All services must declare secrets. Dev stack also needs update. CI tests set env vars directly.
Config change only. Combined with port removal, no external access possible.
Functional requirement - video generation will fail with placeholder keys. No code change, just secret values.
Adding healthchecks may cause services to be marked unhealthy if endpoints not ready. Need appropriate start_period/retries.
Script logic fix only. Makes validation stricter (rejects 'none', requires vault unsealed).
